adult.src: Weight types: Association of Anaesthetists and SOBA, Peri-operative management of the obese surgical patient 2015 (Table 3; suxamethonium from the text). IBW = height (cm) − 100 (men) or − 105 (women); LBW by Janmahasatian; AdjBW = IBW + 0.4 × (TBW − IBW). Doses per kg are the app's own adult doses. Suggested starting points for healthy obese adults: titrate to effect.

paeds.src: Weight types and doses: Barts Health guideline, Dosing of anaesthetic and analgesic drugs in obese children over 2 years (2021), which follows the NPPG 0.35 adjustment and SOBA paediatric guidance. IBW = BMI at the 50th centile for age and sex (RCPCH UK90 charts) × height (m)²; AdjBW = IBW + 0.35 × (TBW − IBW). Never exceed the adult dose.
